name: Izanami
subtitle: Great Mother
lore: Initially one of Izumo’s creator deities, Izanami died giving birth. She waited in Yomi, the underworld, for her husband Izanagi to retrieve her—yet when he attempted to do so, he fled, horrified at her newly decayed appearance. Now that the Shattering has weakened the barriers between worlds, she wreaks her vengeance by sending monstrous horrors into the realm of the living.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when placing a [Debuff] on an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Ignore RES +20%, Divinity Multiplier +20%, C.DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Withering Essence
skills.description: Remove [mechanic:shield] from all enemies then attack all enemies (160%ATK+500%ACC) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:corrupt] on the target with the highest HP for 3 turns. If Izanagi is on the team, he will join the attack using his Core ability.

skills.name: Yomi Malediction
skills.description: Attack all enemies (100%ATK+500%ACC) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:spd-down-ii] and [mechanic:curse-ii] on each target for 2 turns then decrease their Turn Meter by 20%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Will steal Turn Meter from all enemies instead.

skills.name: Eternal Decay
skills.description: When this hero attacks an enemy under [INIT Down] decrease their turn meter by 5%.
skills.awakening_bonus: If an enemy is defeated when under [INIT Down], place [Banish] on them for 1 Turn.

skills.name: Fading Slash
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (120%ATK+500%ACC) with a 40% chance to place [mechanic:init-down-ii] on the target for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also decrease the target’s Divinity by 100.

imprint_passive: When attacking enemies under [INIT Down] decrease their turn meter by 2.5%.
